berkaatilla: Marek Berkaatilla left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Brennmoor and came up the line with a stub of a pencil. The men noticed at once that he draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters.
chickenmcnugget2025: The draft reached S-C15 on Day 9. Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
ghostrider_q3f: Benedikt Ghostrider arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a bullet that missed him and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
gilbertjamesthe4th: After 9 days of war, S-C15 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames.
gsh1ngles: After 9 days of war, R-R13 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Felix "Mole" Ngles.
keaganwilson085: At the depot, Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson had practised answering to his name. At R-C10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
lauri.joki: Clement "Mud" Joki arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a pocket Bible with a hole in it and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
x0mb13_06: The old hands of T-F9 have been here since Day 1. Dorian "Lucky" Xmb has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
